reason: Single-file expression-context bug fix adjusting the default UTF8MB4 collation in `StaticExprContext`, with a matching unit test. Although collation affects SQL semantics, the metadata points to a narrow default-value correction in one helper/context implementation rather than a broad planner/executor/runtime or storage behavior change, so it is less likely to hide Blocker/High issues warranting a 20-40 minute deep review.
